actors.name: Jean-Pierre Dupont
actors.private_context: Dupont is the French Ambassador to Germany. He has received instructions from the French government to deliver a protest note to the German Foreign Office regarding the ongoing diplomatic crisis. He is aware of the ultimatum's expiration on July 28, 1914, and intends to deliver the note before that deadline.

actors.name: German Foreign Office
actors.private_context: The German Foreign Office is the recipient of diplomatic communications. It operates during normal business hours and has protocols for receiving official notes from foreign ambassadors. It is aware of the ultimatum and the general diplomatic tensions.

shared_context: The date is July 23, 1914. Diplomatic tensions are high following the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand. France and Germany are in a crisis. The German ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914. Ambassador Dupont has a protest note to deliver to the German Foreign Office.

starting_events.description: Ambassador Dupont prepares to deliver the protest note to the German Foreign Office.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ambassador Dupont actually delivered the protest note to the German Foreign Office before the ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914 at 23:59. Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
